description: The exact original Might and Magic VII ultra dragon: a slender upright flying dragon with charcoal-black finely scaled hide, dark crimson-red ridges and highlights, long curved neck, narrow angular reptilian head, small red-orange eyes and a long toothed muzzle. A crown of many long ivory-gold horns sweeps upward and backward from the skull; preserve their native count, length and silhouette. Golden ochre overlapping chevron belly plates run down the long neck and chest. Four separate slender clawed legs: small bent forelegs held in front of the torso and two rear legs hanging beneath the hips, all with pale ivory-blue claws. Two large bat wings have dark red-black struts, sharply scalloped golden-orange membranes with mottled scale-like veining, deep dark olive shadows, and long pointed wing fingertips. Preserve each wing fold, sweep, angle and body occlusion from the native frame. A very long slender dark tail with red ridges and ivory dorsal spikes curves behind the body, ending in a small pale ivory multi-pointed spiked tip. Preserve the long neck, small head, narrow body, exact four-leg anatomy, native dark tonal weight and exact flying orientation. No clothing, armor, harness, weapons, extra limbs or added horns. Match only effects actually present in a native attack frame; add no glow, fire, particles, ground, shadow or environment. One native palette only: charcoal-black body, gold-orange wing membranes and golden belly, red ridges, pale horns and claws remain consistent in every pose.

materials.limitation: Single native palette; no recoloring required.
